theorem_statement: The five three-edge Petersen matchings form an invariant system under the full automorphism group of native G60. The induced action on the five matching blocks is the full symmetric group S5. Its kernel is exactly the native free V4, so Aut(G60)/V4 is isomorphic to S5 through this five-block action.

interpretation.earned: The five-matching partition is not merely an editorial coordinate pattern. It is preserved by all 480 graph automorphisms and realizes the canonical five-point quotient action.
interpretation.factorization: The native sixty-state register resolves equivariantly as five matching blocks, three chambers per block, and four native V4 states per chamber.
interpretation.foreign_v4_bridge: The fifteen foreign V4 stabilizers occupy the three internal block pairs across five matching blocks. The S5 quotient acts faithfully on the five blocks and hence on their pair geometry.
